personalizedAssistant: Your personalized fitness and nutrition tracking assistant.
calTrackDescription: CalTrack provides you with tools to calculate your personalized daily calorie intake based on your gender, age, height, weight, and activity level. Adjust your intake to lose weight, gain weight, or maintain your current weight while keeping your nutrition balanced.
bmrExplanation: The calculator uses proven formulas to estimate your Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and adjusts it based on your activity level:
sedentaryDescription: For mostly sitting work (e.g., office jobs).
moderatelyActiveDescription: For walking work (e.g., sales reps, servers).
activeDescription: For jobs involving a lot of physical activity (e.g., builders).
veryActiveDescription: For intense physical labor or high sports activity.
calorieGoalsDescription: Based on your goals, CalTrack predicts your daily calorie intake to:
loseWeightDescription: Lose 0.5 - 1 kg per week in a healthy way.
maintainWeightDescription: Stay at your current weight with balanced nutrition.
gainWeightDescription: Gain 0.5 - 1 kg per week in a sustainable way.
joinCalTrack: Join thousands of others achieving their goals with CalTrack. Register now to start tracking your fitness journey!
pleaseLogIn: Please log in to view your profile.
